title: New Dragon Ball Super Remake Just Dropped Big Tease for Vegeta’s Strongest Form
content:
Dragon Ball Super is currently working its way through a new remake anime series this Fall, and the newest episode is setting up a big transformation for Vegeta’s future with one of its key changes. Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has been showing off an enhanced version of the original TV anime series, and with it has been making some changes to how that anime played out to make this the most definitive version yet. While some of these changes have been better received than others , the anime is dropping some big clues about Vegeta’s strongest form.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is an officially enhanced version of the classic TV anime series leading the way to the eventual premiere of Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patro l, a new anime adapting the Galactic Patrol Prisoner arc from the manga series. But this also means we’ll eventually see an anime for the Granolah the Survivor arc after, and with it the debut of Vegeta’s strongest form, Ultra Ego. A form that seems him completely enveloped in a violet aura much like the new way his Super Saiyan 2 form looks in the remake.

Dragon Ball Super’s Vegeta Update Gives Him a Purple Aura

As seen in the latest episode of Dragon Ball Super: Beerus , Vegeta uses his Super Saiyan 2 transformation and it’s given a purple aura as part of the enhancements seen with other transformations thus far. While this falls more in line with the purple aura and abilities seen with Vegeta’s more classic abilities, this holds a lot more meaning now that fans of the Dragon Ball Super manga have seen Vegeta go on to unlock the godly Ultra Ego form in the Granolah the Survivor Arc. The arc that immediately follows the Galactic Patrol Prisoner Arc in the manga.

Vegeta’s Ultra Ego form puts him about on the same level of power as Goku’s own Ultra Instinct, but it’s a form that is something only Vegeta himself can tap into . Without training in the same way as Goku did (as Vegeta is unable to quiet his mind in the same way), he instead leans into his rage and aggression to unleash his own godly power in this way. And with the anime already further separating Vegeta’s aura in this way with this change, it’s one step closer to Ultra Ego’s anime debut.

Will Dragon Ball Super’ s Anime Adapt the Granolah the Survivor Arc?

The big question is whether or not Dragon Ball Super will eventually adapt the Granolah the Survivor arc at this time, unfortunately. It’s thankfully also more a matter of when as with the confirmation that Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol is now in the works, Toei Animation and Bird Studio have also revealed their intent to adapt these manga arcs into anime. But with no release window or date set for the first of these new anime arcs as of this time , it could mean fans wait for a long time before Vegeta’s Ultra Ego form his screens.

New forms like Vegeta’s Ultra Ego, all of the advancements Goku makes with Ultra Instinct , and Black Frieza are why fans are so excited to eventually see these manga exclusive arcs getting their own anime adaptation in the near future. With the remake series making this seemingly small change to Vegeta now, it’s planting some big seeds for what’s to come in the future. Are you hoping to see Vegeta’s Ultra Ego in action soon? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Crunchyroll to Stream Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3 Anime
content:
Crunchyroll announced on Wednesday that it will stream Mashle: Magic and Muscles - Tri-Magicathalon Divine Visionary Final Exam Arc , the third season based on Hajime Kōmoto 's Mashle: Magic and Muscles manga, in January. Crunchyroll will stream the anime worldwide excluding Japan and China.

• Chiaki Kobayashi as Mash Burnedead

• Kaito Ishikawa as Lance Crown

• Reiji Kawashima as Finn Ames

• Reina Ueda as Lemon Irvine

• Takuya Eguchi as Dot Barrett

Confirmed returning staff members include director Tomoya Tanaka at A-1 Pictures , scriptwriter and series composition writer Yōsuke Kuroda , and composer Masaru Yokoyama . Chiaki Furuzumi (chief animation director and sub-character designer for Solo Leveling both seasons) is replacing Hisashi Higashijima as the character designer.

The anime's first season premiered in Japan in April 2023 and aired for 12 episodes. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired, and it streamed an English dub . The second season premiered in January 2024 and aired for 12 episodes. Crunchyroll again streamed the series as it aired and streamed an English dub .

The overall anime project is listed as a "complete" anime adaptation.

Both Viz Media 's Shonen Jump service and Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service published the manga digitally in English. Viz Media is also releasing the manga in print. Shueisha describes the manga:

This is a world of magic where magic is used for everything. But deep in the forest exists a young man who spends his time training and bulking up. He can't use magic, but he enjoys a peaceful life with his father. But one day, his life is put in danger! Will his muscular body protect him from the magic users who are out to get him? Powerfully trained muscles crush magic as this abnormal magical fantasy begins!

The series launched in Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in Japan in January 2020, and ended in July 2023. Shueisha published the manga's 18th and final compiled book volume, as well as a fanbook, in October 2023. The franchise also includes several novels and two stage play adaptations .

Mashle : Muscle Puzzle , a smartphone puzzle game in the franchise , launched in April 2025.

title: Major Shonen Jump Anime Confirms Crunchyroll Return for Season 3 – Watch Trailer
content:
A major Shonen Jump anime has now confirmed it’s coming back to Crunchyroll with Season 3 next year, and a new trailer is helping to show it off. With the Fall 2026 anime schedule now underway, there are all sorts of new anime that are starting to be announced for a release next year. These include many of the franchises from Shonen Jump magazine, and some of which will be returning for new episodes in the coming year as well. Such as Hajime Komoto’s Mashle: Magic and Muscles.

Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3 is currently scheduled for a return early next year as part of the new wave of anime kicking off 2027 on a hopefully strong start , and a new update from Crunchyroll has confirmed that they will exclusively be streaming the new episodes when they hit in Japan in January. To help celebrate the new season coming to the platform, you can check out the trailer for Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3 below.

Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3 Confirms 2027 Crunchyroll Release

Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3 will be making its debut sometime in January as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule, but no concrete release date has been announced as of the time of this writing. Much like the first two seasons that you can catch up with on the platform in the meantime, Crunchyroll will be streaming the new episodes when they hit for fans worldwide excluding Japan and China. And it’s going to be picking up right from where the second season left off as Mash and the others are working through a major exam.

Officially titled MASHLE: MAGIC AND MUSCLES The Tri-Magicathlon Divine Visionary Final Exam Arc , the new season is going to be taking on the next phase of the Divine Visionary Exam. It’s full of some pretty huge fights for Mash and the others, so it remains to be seen what kind of action we’ll see in motion when it hits. Mashle: Magic and Muscles isn’t that long of a series overall either, so each new season of the anime actually brings it all much closer to the end than fans might be ready for.

What to Know for Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3

MASHLE: MAGIC AND MUSCLES The Tri-Magicathlon Divine Visionary Final Exam Arc will feature a mostly returning production staff from the second season with Tomoya Tanaka returning as director for A-1 Pictures, Yosuke Kuroda returning as series writer, and Masaru Yokoyama composing the music. One notable change behind the scenes sees Chiaki Furuzumi taking over as character designer from Hisashi Higashijima seen with the second season. Which would explain the updated looks for everyone.

Mashle: Magic and Muscles has been one of the more successful jumps to anime seen in the last few years from Shonen Jump, and that’s due to the balance of comedy and action fans get with each episode. It’s a main character just absolutely breaking all of the norms of his world filled with magic, and as a result, it’s made for some fun surprises. Are you ready for Mashle ‘s return for Season 3? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Bandai Namco Announces Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 3 Game for PS5, PC
content:
Bandai Namco Entertainment announced on Wednesday during the Gundam Games 40th Anniversary livestream the new Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 3 game for PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam . The company unveiled a trailer that previews the gameplay:

The free-to-play team combat game will feature an expanded Mobile Suit roster from multiple Gundam series, starting with those in the Universal Century universe and Mobile Suit Gundam Seed . Every unit will have "SP Skills." There will also be a new "Battle Assist" feature and a new user interface. There will be cross-play between systems.

Bandai Namco Entertainment released the free-to-play Mobile Suit Gundam : Battle Operation 2 game on the PlayStation 4 in Japan in July 2018. The game then debuted in English for the PS4 digitally in October 2019. The game launched for PS5 in January 2021. The game got a release on PC via Steam in May 2023. The game is a sequel to the Mobile Suit Gundam : Battle Operation and Mobile Suit Gundam : Battle Operation Next games.

Gundam Rogue Orbit , a new game in the Gundam franchise , will launch for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam on March 5, 2027.

title: Cardfight!! Vanguard Announces New Veil Lift Anime, 2nd Season of Ghost Meets Gal Mini Anime
content:
The official X/Twitter account for the Cardfight!! Vanguard franchise announced on Wednesday the new Cardfight!! Vanguard Veil Lift television anime. The franchise also announced a second season for the mini anime adaptation of Kaeru DX 's Ghost Meets Gal manga . The account shared an announcement video for the former and an announcement image for the latter.

More details for Cardfight!! Vanguard Veil Lift will be announced on December 7.

The franchise previously teased that a completely new television anime will air in 2027 to commemorate the franchise 's 15th anniversary.

The three-episode Cardfight!! Vanguard Divinez Unmei Seisen-hen ( Cardfight!! Vanguard Divinez The Fated Star Battle Arc) anime, the " final arc " of the franchise 's DivineZ saga, will premiere on TV Aichi and six TV Tokyo stations on November 7 at 8:00 a.m. JST. The anime will also stream on ABEMA , d Anime Store , DMM TV , Hulu , Prime Video, U-NEXT , Nico Nico , and other streaming services in Japan starting on November 7. . Kis-My-Ft2 perform the theme song "Escape." Toshiya Miyata , member of Kis-My-Ft2 and voice of protagonist Akina Myōdō, wrote the theme song's lyrics.

The anime first opened in theaters in Japan on October 2. Kinema Citrus animated the film, again featuring original character designs by manga creator group CLAMP .

The Ghost Meets Gal mini anime debuted on September 5 at 8:00 a.m. JST. AtoriE is producing the mini anime.

Karin Kagami (voice of Urara Haneyama in Cardfight!! Vanguard will+Dress ) voices Rubuna (left in image above), and Yūka Nishio (voice of Nao Inabe in Cardfight!! Vanguard Divinez ) voices Santi in the mini anime. BanG Dream! 's Mugendai Mewtype band performs the mini anime's theme song "Nikoichi Mirai."

The Cardfight!! Vanguard overDress anime's first two seasons launched the franchise 's "D Series" in April 2021. The Cardfight!! Vanguard will+Dress anime's first season, which premiered in July 2022, is considered the third overall season of the D Series. The second and third seasons (which premiered in January 2023 and July 2023 respectively) are the D Series' fourth and fifth seasons, respectively.

The series' sixth season is the Cardfight!! Vanguard Divinez anime , which debuted in Japan in January 2024. Cardfight!! Vanguard Divinez Season 2 debuted in July 2024 as the overall seventh season.

The Cardfight!! Vanguard Divinez DELUXE Arc ( Cardfight!! Vanguard Divinez Deluxe-hen ) anime then premiered in January 2025 and is the eighth season. The Cardfight!! Vanguard Divinez DELUXE Finals ( Cardfight!! Vanguard Divinez Deluxe Kesshō-hen ) anime premiered in July 2025 and aired its 12th and final episode on October 4.

Bushiroad originally announced that it would produce up to nine seasons for the current "D Series" of the Cardfight!! Vanguard anime. The company then later announced it was planning the 10th season and beyond for the D Series.

title: South Park Confirms Kenny’s Replacement in New Season 29 Episode First Look Trailer – Watch Now
content:
South Park has dropped the first look at Season 29’s next big episode, and with it confirmed a new replacement for Kenny. South Park Season 29 kicked off its new run of episodes this year with some big changes. Not only did the name of the show and town change to “South America,” but Kenny was killed off again for the first time in six years . As the episodes continued, however, Kenny has remained dead throughout and it left a whole open in the main group of boys.

South Park Season 29 then presented a potential new replacement for Kenny with its most recent episode as Randy was turned into a kid and forced to go to school with the boys , and now it’s been revealed that Randy’s going to stay this way for at least the next episode as the first look at South Park Season 29 Episode 4 reveals he’s now considered one of the “four boys” the episode will be focused on. Check out the tease for the episode below.

South Park Season 29 Episode 4 Confirms Release Date & Synopsis

South Park Season 29 Episode 4 is titled “Guinea Pig On A Stick” and will be making its debut with Comedy Central on Wednesday, October 28th at 10PM ET/PT before being available to stream exclusively with Paramount+ the next day in the United States, Canada and Australia. While the new kid version of Randy is not seen in the new teaser itself, he’s been fully revealed in the new promotional image (which you can see below) alongside Cartman, Kyle and Stan . And when digging into the synopsis, the four of them are lumped in together.

“When South America’s beef becomes highly prized and sought after, the four boys fight to keep it in local hands,” the synopsis for the episode teases. This new kid version of Randy popped up as part of a Backrooms inspired joke on Sephora , and didn’t seem like it would be reversed with the next episode. With the looser serialized elements between each of the episodes this season, it was hard to gauge whether or not the series would go back on this decision by its next episode. Thankfully that’s not the case as this new version of Randy is here to stay.

What Does This Mean for Randy’s Future in South Park ?

South Park has made some big changes for Randy over the last couple of years. Not only did the series finally close down Tegridy Farms and move the Marsh family back to town , but Randy was left without a new job or something to do for the episodes moving forward. The premiere for this new season teased that he would be obsessed with cycling for the season, but making him a part of the core group of boys offers up a whole new wave of potential jokes for Randy moving forward.

There are South Park fans who believe Randy has dominated much of the series for the last few years, and merging him into a renewed focus on the boys is likely going to further divide those fans. It feels like both a step forward and step back for the series, but at least this way Randy will be involved in whatever main story the boys are involved with instead of dominating an episode with something completely outside of them. He would’ve taken up a lot of screen time either way, so this could be a best of both worlds situation.

How do you feel about Randy being Kenny’s new replacement in South Park Season 29? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: The Greatest Magicmaster’s Retirement Plan Anime Unveils Tesfia Character Visual
content:
The Greatest Magicmaster’s Retirement Plan anime unveiled a new visual featuring the character Tesfia “Fia” Fable on Wednesday. It was also announced the voice actress Eri Yukimura will voice the character. The series is set to premiere in 2027.

Yusuke Suzuki directs the anime while, the series composition is handled by Juichiro Ichikawa ( Jobraver , Himitsu no AiPri ), and Yuki Kitajima is on character designs. Takatoshi Hamano is the sound director, with animation production by HOTLINE. The previously announced voice cast includes:

• Yuto Uemura as Alus Reigin

title: Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms Season 2 Reveals New Visual, Digest Video
content:
The upcoming Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms Season 2 revealed a new premiere visual featuring the main character Mona Kawai on Wednesday. A digest video recapping the first season was also released.

Studio SynergySP will return to animate the sequel with Yoshiaki Okumura also returning as director. The cast will also reprise their roles:

• Ryota Iwasaki as Medaka Kuroiwa

• Yu Serizawa as Mona Kawai

• Sora Amamiya as Asahi Shonan

• Kana Hanazawa as Tsubomi Haruno

• Hinaki Yano as Tomo Namba

• Kaori Maeda as Minami Shirahama

Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms anime is based on a manga written and illustrated by Ran Kuze. It was originally launched as a one-shot in Kodansha’s Weekly Shonen Magazine in December 2020, and later began serialization in the same magazine in May 2021. Kodansha USA is publishing the manga in English. Crunchyroll is streaming the first season, describing it as: For Mona Kawai, winning hearts and turning heads comes naturally. Everything changes when Medaka Kuroiwa, a new transfer student, arrives. He won’t even give Mona a second look, and it turns her life upside down! Mona tries everything she can to win Medaka over, even going to the extreme at times. Tune in to a new rom-com about a queen bee and an unfazed boy among the school’s halls.

title: Hatsune Miku Connecting Puzzle TAMAGOTORI Deluxe Game Launches on October 29
content:
Crypton Future Media announced on Thursday that the Hatsune Miku Connecting Puzzle TAMAGOTORI Deluxe game will launch for the PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and PC via Steam and Microsoft Store on October 29. The game contains the original Hatsune Miku Connecting Puzzle TAMAGOTORI game along with its two DLC packs.

The game features egg-matching gameplay to reveal special illustrations.

The original game launched in 2022 for Switch.

Crypton Future Media and Good Smile Company 's Hatsune Miku Nendoroid Starry Party 3D party game will launch for the Switch 2 and PC via Steam in 2027.

COLORFUL STAGE! The Movie: A Miku Who Can't Sing ( Gekijо̄ban Project Sekai: Kowareta Sekai to Utaenai Miku , or The Broken World and a Miku Who Can't Sing), the anime film based on the Project Sekai: Colorful Stage feat. Hatsune Miku smartphone game , opened in Japan on January 17. It debuted at #2 and sold 232,500 tickets and earned 306,817,000 yen (about US$2.15 million in current conversion) in its first three days.

GKIDS acquired the film's North American theatrical rights, and initially screened the film in the U.S. in April 2025 and in Canada in May 2025. The company released the film digitally on Amazon Prime Video , AppleTV, Google Movies, YouTube Movies, and Fandango At Home . The company then released the Collector's Edition Blu-ray Disc set on April 14.

The Project Sekai: Colorful Stage feat. Hatsune Miku smartphone game launched in Japan in September 2020. The game is a collaboration between Sega , Crypton Future Media , and Colorful Palette , a subsidiary of Craft Egg . Sega and Colorful Palette released the game globally as Hatsune Miku: Colorful Stage! on iOS and Android devices in December 2021.

The game inspired a mini anime adaptation titled Petit Seka ( Puchi Seka ) . The anime had 10 episodes, and streamed for free on YouTube .

Hatsune Miku Project Diva Mega Mix ( Hatsune Miku: Project Diva Mega39's ) launched digitally in the West for Nintendo Switch game in May 2020. The game got a PC release in May 2022.

title: The Greatest Magicmaster's Retirement Plan TV Anime Casts Eri Yukimura
content:
The staff for the television anime of writer Izushiro and illustrator Ruria Miyuki 's The Greatest Magicmaster's Retirement Plan ( Saikyō Mahōshi no Inton Keikaku ) light novel series announced on Wednesday that the anime will air in the "Agaru Anime" programming block on CBC , TBS , and 26 other affiliated channels next year. The anime's staff also announced that Eri Yukimura is voicing Tesfia "Fia" Fable, an ice magic user and a first-year student at the magical institute Alus attends.

J-Novel Club is publishing the light novels in English and describes the story:

In a world where the Fiends run rampant... Magicmaster Alus Reigin, the young prodigy that has defeated more Fiends and reclaimed more of humanity's lost territory than anyone else alive, requests retirement from military service at age 16. But due to the twists and turns of fate surrounding his status as the No. 1 Magicmaster in the nation—the top Magicmaster out of more than 100,000—he ends up as a student at a special magical institute, hiding his identity and training his successors – a pair of beautiful Magicmaster girls! Not to mention continuing to defeat Fiends in secret.

The anime stars Yūto Uemura as protagonist Alus Reigin, and Yui Ogura as Loki Leevahl.

Yūsuke Suzuki ( This Monster Wants to Eat Me , Duel Masters Win ) is directing the anime at HOTLINE . Gigaemon Ichikawa ( Himitsu no AiPri , A Galaxy Next Door ) is in charge of series scripts, Yūki Kitajima ( The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You , Kakegurui , One Piece episode key animator) is designing the characters, and Takatoshi Hamano ( IDOLiSH7 , Chainsmoker Cat , Ishura ) is the sound director.

To commemorate the novels' anime adaptation, a prequel manga titled Saikyō Mahōshi no Inton Keikaku Zero -Hajimari no Hishi-roku- ( The Greatest Magicmaster's Retirement Plan Zero -The Secret History of the Beginning-) is scheduled to launch this winter. Karu Yoneshiro is again drawing the manga. The manga will depict Alus' life before he enrolled in the magic academy, and will connect to the main story.

Izushiro started publishing the novels on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in 2015. Hobby Japan published the 20th novel volume in December 2025.

Yoneshiro's The Greatest Magicmaster's Retirement Plan - The Alternative - manga launched in Square Enix 's Manga UP! app in 2020. The series ended with its 10th compiled book volume that shipped in January 2024. Comikey publishes the manga in English digitally.

Yoneshiro's manga is the second manga adaptation of the novels. Yū Uonuma 's first manga adaptation serialized in Hobby Japan 's website, and ran for two volumes.
